title: Late Charges Collected with a RentGuard Reinstatement Cure
content:
On a RentGuard Renters Policy cancelled for nonpayment, which of the current term's late charges are collected with the cure depends on the policy's reinstatement record over the last 36 calendar months and on how many late charges were posted in the current term.

## Rule

- When the policy shows no reinstatement in the last 36 calendar months and at most one late charge was posted in the current term, no late charge is collected with the cure and the current term's late charges stay on the reinstated account.
- When the policy shows no reinstatement in the last 36 calendar months and more than one late charge was posted in the current term, only the latest late charge of the current term is collected with the cure and the others stay on the reinstated account.
- When a reinstatement was recorded in the last 36 calendar months, every late charge of the current term is collected with the cure.

## How the records show it

- A late charge is a fee entry on the premium account with fee code late fee; it belongs to the current term when it is charged for the term now running.
- A reinstatement shows on the premium account as an additional premium entry with change reason reinstatement reversal, one per reinstatement; one posted within the last 36 calendar months counts, one posted earlier does not.
- The latest late charge of the current term is the one posted most recently.

## Decision table

| Reinstatement in the last 36 calendar months | Late charges posted in the current term | Collected with the cure | Stays on the reinstated account |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | none | nothing | nothing |
| none | exactly one | nothing | that late charge |
| none | two or more | the latest late charge only | every other late charge of the term |
| one or more | none | nothing | nothing |
| one or more | one or more | every late charge of the current term | nothing |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical policy has three late charges in the current term, of 5.00, 5.00 and, most recently, 6.10.

- With no reinstatement in the last 36 calendar months, 6.10 is collected with the cure and the two charges of 5.00 stay on the reinstated account.
- With a reinstatement reversal posted 20 months ago, all three charges, 16.10 in total, are collected with the cure.
- With a single late charge of 5.00 in the term and no reinstatement in the last 36 calendar months, nothing is collected with the cure and the 5.00 stays on the reinstated account.
